Placemaker.Polish.Name: Look
Placemaker.Polish.sideReach.Tooltip: How far a garden reaches sideways to meet the neighbour beside it. Very large values make outgrow slower in big cities.
Placemaker.Polish.maxFrontGap.Tooltip: Two neighbours this far apart at the street still join (one shared fence or hedge).
Placemaker.Polish.maxBackGap.Tooltip: How far apart their back corners may be (wedges on the outside of a curve).
Placemaker.Polish.maxRearGap.Tooltip: Two gardens back to back this far apart meet in the middle.
Placemaker.Polish.maxFacingGap.Tooltip: Two lots this far apart meet halfway, at any angle (a block's corners, two streets that meet): the land between them is shared on one line.
Placemaker.Polish.maxDeepen.Tooltip: A shallow garden reaches back to its row's deepest by up to this much.
Placemaker.Polish.hug.Tooltip: A side or back nobody else has grows out to a road, path or building near it and hugs it.
Placemaker.Polish.hugReach.Tooltip: How far a garden reaches out to a road, path or building.
Placemaker.Polish.openReach.Tooltip: A side or back with nothing near it still grows this far into open land (a car park or paving: only its back). Very large values fill whole fields.
Placemaker.Polish.maxSlope.Tooltip: A garden stops growing where the land gets steeper than this, so it never climbs a cliff. 80 %: only real cliffs and walls stop it. 0: no limit.
Placemaker.Polish.maxRise.Tooltip: A garden stops growing where the land is more than this above or below its house (m). 0: no limit (the default).
Placemaker.Polish.deckClearance.Tooltip: A garden grows under an elevated road or a bridge only where its road is at least this high above the ground (m). Lower, it is a crack and nothing grows there. Trees never grow under one.
Placemaker.Polish.wrap.Tooltip: Two deep gardens meet behind a shallow one between them.
Placemaker.Polish.closeBacks.Tooltip: A garden open at the back closes with a fence or hedge the joining freed.
Placemaker.Polish.closeGardens.Tooltip: Every open edge of a garden (not its street front) gets fence or hedge pieces, following its bends and the roads it hugs.
Placemaker.Polish.fenceKind.Tooltip: What closes the open edges: the house's own fence or hedge kind, or one for every house.
Placemaker.Polish.lawns.Tooltip: A garden's lawn grows to its new fences, around driveways and paving.
Placemaker.Polish.lawnReach.Tooltip: Mowed lawn this far from the house; a big garden is painted further out. 400 or more: lawn everywhere.
Placemaker.Polish.paintedGardens.Tooltip: How many gardens are painted instead of keeping their lawns. Natural and Yard more often, Tidy seldom.
Placemaker.Polish.gardenPaint.Tooltip: How strong the paint of a painted garden is.
Placemaker.Polish.paint.Tooltip: Soft ground past the gardens and worn ground along fences facing open land.
Placemaker.Polish.blendWidth.Tooltip: How far the paint reaches past the gardens.
Placemaker.Polish.blendFar.Tooltip: How far the fainter, wider band reaches.
Placemaker.Polish.blendStrength.Tooltip: How strong the paint past the gardens is.
Placemaker.Polish.gardenLayer.Tooltip: The ground a painted garden is painted with.
Placemaker.Polish.meadowLayer.Tooltip: The ground of a big garden beyond its lawn near the house.
Placemaker.Polish.blendLayer.Tooltip: The ground of the band just past the gardens.
Placemaker.Polish.blendFarLayer.Tooltip: The ground of the wider, fainter band further out.
Placemaker.Polish.edgeLayer.Tooltip: Worn ground along back fences that face open land.
Placemaker.Polish.edgeWidth.Tooltip: How wide the worn band along those fences is.
Placemaker.Polish.roadLayer.Tooltip: A band along the roads and paths beside the gardens.
Placemaker.Polish.roadWidth.Tooltip: How wide the band along roads and paths is.
Placemaker.Polish.rockLayer.Tooltip: The ground under rock gardens and outcrops.
Placemaker.Polish.rockGround.Tooltip: The wider ground around an outcrop.
Placemaker.Polish.yardLayer.Tooltip: The ground of a storage yard.
Placemaker.Polish.patchLayer.Tooltip: The ground of the worn patches in big gardens.
Placemaker.Polish.patchChance.Tooltip: How many worn patches big gardens get.
Placemaker.Polish.plant.Tooltip: Planted beds with bushes along new fences. Off: no planting, features, paths or rocks.
Placemaker.Polish.bedChance.Tooltip: How often a new fence gets a bed with bushes.
Placemaker.Polish.bushesPerGarden.Toolti: The most bushes the beds of one garden get.
Placemaker.Polish.features.Tooltip: Big new garden land gets something by its look: a rock garden, a sand pit, a log pile, a bench nook, a flower garden, a storage yard.
Placemaker.Polish.featureChance.Tooltip: How many big gardens get a feature.
Placemaker.Polish.featureSpacing.Tooltip: A big garden gets one more feature for every this much new land (at most 6).
Placemaker.Polish.featureMinLand.Tooltip: New garden land a feature needs.
Placemaker.Polish.rockChance.Tooltip: How often a rock sits where two gardens meet at the street (never against a hedge).
Placemaker.Polish.pathChance.Tooltip: How many big gardens get a paved path from the house to the back.
Placemaker.Polish.alleys.Tooltip: A narrow even gap between two houses becomes a paved walkway.
Placemaker.Polish.alleyChance.Tooltip: How often a narrow gap becomes a walkway.
Placemaker.Polish.pavedFill.Tooltip: Shops, offices and works fill the land between them with the surface most of their ground already is, not lawn.
Placemaker.Polish.zoneArea.Tooltip: On: the empty zone cells of the area get the zones below, as lots that start at the road. Off: only the buildings already there are edited (each zone type by its own Outgrow settings).
Placemaker.Polish.zoneA.Tooltip: The main zone of the area.
Placemaker.Polish.zoneB.Tooltip: A second zone mixed in (its share below).
Placemaker.Polish.zoneC.Tooltip: A third zone mixed in (its share below).
Placemaker.Polish.zoneAssetA.Tooltip: Any zone of the game (mods' zones too) instead of the zone type above.
Placemaker.Polish.zoneAssetB.Tooltip: Any zone of the game instead of the second zone type.
Placemaker.Polish.zoneAssetC.Tooltip: Any zone of the game instead of the third zone type.
Placemaker.Polish.shareA.Tooltip: How much of the land the main zone gets (%); what the zones leave stays empty.
Placemaker.Polish.shareB.Tooltip: How much of the land the second zone gets (%). 0: none.
Placemaker.Polish.shareC.Tooltip: How much of the land the third zone gets (%). 0: none.
Placemaker.Polish.zonePattern.Tooltip: How the lots of the zones follow each other along the roads: at random, in clumps of lots alike, or spread evenly.
Placemaker.Polish.zoneGrain.Tooltip: About how many lots in a row get the same zone.
Placemaker.Polish.levelLots.Tooltip: On sloped land every lot becomes level at the height it meets its road, with banks blending into the land around (painted). A lot that would need more earth than the limit is made shallower, or left empty. Lots already level are left alone.
Placemaker.Polish.levelEarth.Tooltip: The deepest cut or highest fill a lot may need (m). Lots on steeper land are made shallower or left empty.
Placemaker.Polish.levelBank.Tooltip: No bank around the levelled lots is steeper than this (50 % = 1 in 2).
Placemaker.Polish.levelWalls.Tooltip: Where a lot's back meets ground 2.6 m or more above it (the lot behind it, or the hill), a concrete wall stands there with a walk along its top, instead of a bank that takes the lots' ground. The lot behind gives up the row under the walk.
Placemaker.Polish.roadRule.Tooltip: The blocks along roads at least this wide get their own zone (shops along the big roads…).
Placemaker.Polish.roadZone.Tooltip: The zone the cells along the big roads get.
Placemaker.Polish.roadMinWidth.Tooltip: How wide a road must be for the road rule.
Placemaker.Polish.roadDepth.Tooltip: How deep the lots along those roads are, in zone cells.
Placemaker.Polish.widthMinA.Tooltip: The narrowest lot of the main zone along the road, in zone cells (8 m).
Placemaker.Polish.widthMaxA.Tooltip: The widest lot of the main zone along the road, in zone cells.
Placemaker.Polish.depthMinA.Tooltip: The shallowest lot of the main zone back from the road, in zone cells.
Placemaker.Polish.depthMaxA.Tooltip: The deepest lot of the main zone back from the road, in zone cells (6 at most).
Placemaker.Polish.widthMinB.Tooltip: The narrowest lot of the second zone along the road, in zone cells (8 m).
Placemaker.Polish.widthMaxB.Tooltip: The widest lot of the second zone along the road, in zone cells.
Placemaker.Polish.depthMinB.Tooltip: The shallowest lot of the second zone back from the road, in zone cells.
Placemaker.Polish.depthMaxB.Tooltip: The deepest lot of the second zone back from the road, in zone cells (6 at most).
Placemaker.Polish.widthMinC.Tooltip: The narrowest lot of the third zone along the road, in zone cells (8 m).
Placemaker.Polish.widthMaxC.Tooltip: The widest lot of the third zone along the road, in zone cells.
Placemaker.Polish.depthMinC.Tooltip: The shallowest lot of the third zone back from the road, in zone cells.
Placemaker.Polish.depthMaxC.Tooltip: The deepest lot of the third zone back from the road, in zone cells (6 at most).
Placemaker.Polish.shapeLots.Tooltip: The lots in the area grow past their borders over the land around them, by the look: shared fences and hedges, lawns, ground, beds, paths (the settings below). They never grow into roads, buildings, other lots, your builds or water. With Zoning on, the houses that grow there later outgrow too. Off: the area is only zoned.
Placemaker.Polish.Nothing: Switch on Zoning or Outgrow: there is nothing to build.
Placemaker.Zoning.Type.suburb.Tooltip: Detached houses with gardens that outgrow their lots. Styles: corner shops, leafy, tight.
Placemaker.Zoning.Type.village.Tooltip: Houses spread out with fields between them, in clumps. Styles: hamlet, village green, country lanes.
Placemaker.Zoning.Type.townhouses.Toolti: Rows of town houses on narrow lots. Styles: terraces, mews, corner shops.
Placemaker.Zoning.Type.mainStreet.Toolti: Shops along the street, homes between them; the big roads get the big shops. Styles: high street, boulevard, market town.
Placemaker.Zoning.Type.townCentre.Toolti: Flats over shops, homes and a few offices: the middle of a town. Styles: old town, new town, square.
Placemaker.Zoning.Type.downtown.Tooltip: Towers: flats, offices and big shops. Styles: business district, city living, shopping.
Placemaker.Zoning.Type.businessPark.Tool: Offices in green grounds. Styles: campus, office strip, tech park.
Placemaker.Zoning.Type.industrial.Toolti: Works and yards. Styles: mixed yards, trade park, big works.
Placemaker.Zoning.Type.seaside.Tooltip: Houses by the water and a few shops. Styles: beach houses, promenade, resort.
Placemaker.Polish.zoneFill.Tooltip: How much of the empty land gets zoned: the rest of the lots along the roads stay empty (mixed in the same way as the zones).
Placemaker.Polish.roadMinA.Tooltip: The narrowest road this zone goes on (m; a two-lane road is 16 m).
Placemaker.Polish.roadMaxA.Tooltip: The widest road this zone goes on (m; 48: any).
Placemaker.Polish.roadMinB.Tooltip: The narrowest road this zone goes on (m; a two-lane road is 16 m).
Placemaker.Polish.roadMaxB.Tooltip: The widest road this zone goes on (m; 48: any).
Placemaker.Polish.roadMinC.Tooltip: The narrowest road this zone goes on (m; a two-lane road is 16 m).
Placemaker.Polish.roadMaxC.Tooltip: The widest road this zone goes on (m; 48: any).
Placemaker.Polish.zoneOutgrow.Tooltip: Each zone type's own Outgrow switch and settings (set in the panel).
Placemaker.Polish.fill.Tooltip: What a building's land past its own lot becomes, whatever the building is: a garden (lawn, fences, beds), a car park yard (green edges, bins, marked bays with parked cars), or paving. The outgrow type alone decides: whatever the building is (a house given a car park type gets a car park).
Placemaker.Polish.parkStyle.Tooltip: How a car park yard looks. Clean: a wide grass edge, trees in planters at the ends of the rows, a tidy bin corner. Everyday: grass edges, bins and stock, most bays taken. Industrial: concrete, no grass, more vans, pallets, barrels, skips and containers, dry worn ground further out.
Placemaker.Polish.parkReach.Tooltip: How far out from the building its car park yard is paved and parked. Further out, the land is the outgrow type's own: its ground, patches, rocks and things.
Placemaker.Polish.parkCars.Tooltip: The share of parking bays with a car or van in them.
Placemaker.Polish.parkWorn.Tooltip: The chance a car park's edge is worn, as the strip malls' are: the ground painted, dirt fading into dry grass out from the paving, no grass strip. Otherwise a grass strip with trees. Industrial car parks are always worn.
Placemaker.Polish.waterGap.Tooltip: How far the land keeps from water: gardens, yards and car parks stop this far from the shore, along a smooth line. The building's own lot is never cut.
